CHECK (
CASE scope
    WHEN '__transaction_capacity'::text THEN (count <= 100000)
    WHEN '__counter_capacity'::text THEN ((count >= 2) AND (count <= 200000))
    WHEN 'binder-start'::text THEN (count <= 6)
    WHEN 'IP-start'::text THEN (count <= 21)
    WHEN 'IP-callback'::text THEN (count <= 21)
    ELSE (count <= 11)
END)

CHECK (((scope <> ALL (ARRAY['__transaction_capacity'::text, '__counter_capacity'::text])) OR ((subject_digest = decode(repeat('00'::text, 32), 'hex'::text)) AND (window_start = '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (expires_at = 'infinity'::timestamp with time zone))))

CHECK ((((consumed_at IS NULL) AND (consumed_provider IS NULL) AND (consumed_subject IS NULL) AND (consumed_user_id IS NULL)) OR ((consumed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (consumed_provider IS NOT NULL) AND (consumed_subject IS NOT NULL) AND (consumed_user_id IS NOT NULL))))

CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN (admission_kind = 'allowlist'::text) THEN ((permitted_subject IS NOT NULL) AND ((octet_length(permitted_subject) >= 1) AND (octet_length(permitted_subject) <= 255)) AND (octet_length(permitted_subject) = char_length(permitted_subject)) AND (issuer = 'https://accounts.google.com'::text) AND (octet_length(token_digest) = 32))
    ELSE (permitted_subject IS NULL)
END)

CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['claimed'::text, 'succeeded'::text, 'failed'::text])) OR (claimed_at IS NOT NULL)))
